source_note: Common regime: Ministerio de Hacienda «Tributación Autonómica. Medidas 2025», Cap. I (regional top marginal rate per community and the base liquidable from which it applies). State part: LIRPF art. 63.1 consolidated (BOE), 24,50 % for base liquidable general above 300.000 €. total_top_rate_pct = 24,5 + regional top rate; it applies only above max(state threshold 300.000 €, regional threshold), i.e. above 300.000 € in every common-regime community. Rates are on the general base (labour/business income), not the savings base. Files downloaded 2026-10-19 into etl/data/raw/public_finance/manual/.

gaps: País Vasco 2025: the official 2025 Basque scale was not downloadable (bizkaia.eus and navarra.es reset the TLS connection from this environment; gipuzkoa.eus and araba.eus pages render the scale only via JavaScript and the 2025 cuadro resumen is not posted). The row carries the official 2024 Gipuzkoa scale (49 % from 204.270 €), confidence medium; verify the 2025 threshold against BOB/BOG/BOTHA before publishing.

Ceuta and Melilla: no own regional scale row. Residents deduct 60 % of the state+regional cuota attributable to income obtained in Ceuta or Melilla (LIRPF art. 68.4, read in the downloaded BOE consolidated text); the marginal rate therefore depends on where income is obtained and is not a single top rate.
threshold_eur is where the regional top rate starts; the combined top rate needs the state 24,5 % too, which starts at 300.000 € (total_top_rate_threshold_eur).
Effective burden also depends on regional minimums, deductions and the savings scale; this file only covers the top statutory marginal rate on the general base.
